name: San Martín Watch
tagline: Starbase launch-day companion: next windows, legal viewing spots, and the land's story.
description: Answers the three things worth knowing before a Starship launch day at Starbase: when the next window sits, where you may lawfully stand to see it once Highway 4 closes, and how the ground under the pad became a launch site. Trackers skip the history: a nineteenth-century land grant that still names the area.
author: ToddATrevino
